description: This PHP source file defines the OAuthClientAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing OAuth client entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting OAuth clients, along with validation rules and internal utility functions.

classes.name: OAuthClientAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for OAuth clients management within the system, providing CRUD operations, validation rules, and internal utility functions, utilizing traits for OAuth services.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieve a paginated list of OAuth clients with optional sorting and filtering.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Create a new OAuth client with a generated secret if confidential.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete one or multiple OAuth clients specified by IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieve details of a specific OAuth client by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update an existing OAuth client's data, including secret regeneration if confidential status changes.

methods.name: setOAuthClient
methods.description: Set OAuth client entity fields based on request parameters.

methods.name: generateSecret
methods.description: Generate a secure secret string for OAuth clients.
